notes.title: First Release Ready
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26113977/f214c32b469d36aac09ed4baefad0cd10b55d0e7.png[/img]
[b] 
Where am I?
Am I still alive?
Woo~
When could be over?
I’m Mr Box, everyday I made the same dream : walk alone in the heavy fog,fall deeply into a space I never been, and then start to run, really fast, like a flash pass through the door one by one, curiously about what is outside the door.The door is not only an exit, but also an entrance. So,this is my dream, Just begin your journey in my dream,help me find the answer.
[/b]

One month passed since last update, and now we are happy to announce that the first release is ready and available on Steam .Here are something we had improved
[b] Levels Part[/b]
1．	Adjusted the levels based on the feedbacks ,comments and
discussions we got,so it is little bit easier than ever before
2．	Added new levels and we have 54 levels, totally.
[b] Story Part[/b]
You may find your own answer of your dream,Not only Mr Box’s.

[b] Art Part[/b]

1.	Add theme name to the level selection scene
2.	Add outline light to the theme 
3.	Add 6 idel animation to the player
4.	Add new animation to main scene
5.	Add credits to the main scene
6.	Change color of Character’s scarf
7.	Optimize player animation when played
8.	Adjust controller button config
9.	Adjust scene fade in and fade out effects
10.	Adjust time of level selection
11.	Adjust all the sounds of background and effect
12.	Fix the Achievement problems
13.	Fix some controller problems
14.	Fix some UI problems
15.	Fix some code problems
16.	Remove the time display panel
